features.description: 73 keys E1-E7 (43 white, 30 black), white/black pattern, key geometry and hit-testing; rendered keybed.
Six ordered sections at the visual-spec widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split, measured aspect, continuous chassis.
Unique stable control ids per section, per-section landmarks and density, drawbars only in Organ, Program/Synth as the only OLEDs.
Pointer and touch press/release/cancel/lost-capture, independent multi-touch, focused-key Space/Enter with repeat suppression, roving focus, blur release.

Every button/knob/fader/drawbar/wheel/stick/encoder moves or lights via pointer and keyboard, and operating all of them changes no audio, voice, display or status. Phase 2: scoped to the controls that remain decorative (Organ, Synth, Program and spec-excluded); functional controls describe what they control. Phase 3: scoped to the spec-excluded (unsupported) controls, whose descriptions say why.
Accessible names, roles, values and descriptions for every control, keyboard focus and operation, aria-pressed toggles, labelled keybed and OLED status regions, visible focus styles.
Note on/off, repeated and overlapping notes, release, all-notes-off, dispose, node/source cleanup to baseline (rendered through the Web Audio simulator).

Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped computer keys with repeat suppression and octave shift, MIDI note/velocity/CC64/CC120/CC123, denied/unsupported/no-input/disconnected MIDI, audible velocity and sustain through the piano voice.
Sustain transitions and multiple sustain sources, concurrent voices, deterministic voice stealing, velocity level and brightness response.

Truthful loading/ready/fallback/error/suspended status and MIDI status; blur, hidden tab, MIDI disconnect, all-notes-off and unmount stop every owned voice and return sources and listeners to baseline.

No marketing hero or reference-image background, attached chassis/cheeks/rails, all 73 keys inside the instrument, stage sizing for 1440x900 (88-97 % width, no vertical scroll) and 390x844 (full-width, scaled as one unit).

Six selectable types (Grand, Upright, Electric, Clav, Digital, Misc) with 1-2 models each; Grand/Upright/Electric play bundled recorded sample packs (roots + velocity layers) offline, audibly distinct from each other and from the synthesized types; provenance in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json matches every pack zone.

Two layers with enable/focus button logic, level faders, octave shift (±12 semitones), per-layer voice ownership (one NoteEngine per layer), layer disable/section off freeing only owned voices, and cleanup to baseline.
KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre (acoustic/electric families incl. Dyno), Unison, Soft Release (not for Clav), String Res and Master Level each measurably change rendered audio and show in panel feedback.

Sustain from the UI toggle, computer keyboard Space and MIDI CC64 through the layered engine, honouring per-layer SUSTPED (Shift+Layer A) including toggling while the pedal is down; String Res responds to the pedal; no soft/sostenuto behaviour is claimed.
A failed sample pack reports 'fallback' (never ready), names the failure in status, Program OLED (LOAD FAILED) and a flashing type LED, and the model still plays the labelled synthesized fallback.

One AudioContext; per-layer buses → Timbre EQ → Mod1 → Mod2 → Delay → Amp/EQ → Comp → Reverb → layer level → (direct | shared Rotary) → master gain → limiter → ceiling → single destination; Master Level 0 silences everything; ramps avoid clicks; dispose frees every node, LFO and voice.

FX focus follows layer focus, manual Piano focus button, Group (Shift+focus), Global for Delay/Comp/Reverb (Shift+On), per-unit bypass, Layer Effects ON all-bypass, dry/wet, documented order (reverb before rotary), delay feedback path, To Rotary routing and shared rotary speed.

Every unit and every listed type (Mod1 x6, Mod2 x6, Delay with Off/HP/LP/BP feedback filter and tap tempo, Amp Sim EQ/Small/JC/Twin/LP24/HP24/To Rotary, Compressor with Fast, Reverb x6 with Bright/Dark, Rotary slow/fast/drive) measurably changes a standardized rendered signal versus bypass and versus the other types.

All Phase 1 test files remain present and green; decorative-only assertions were narrowed to the controls that stay decorative, and the keybed/input/voice lifecycle tests run against the Phase 2 engine through the app.

32 programs and 8 Live slots round-trip every stored area (piano, organ, synth, six effect chains, rotary, split, scenes, morphs, clock, transpose) through storage; Master Level/pitch stick excluded; the E indicator is a truthful comparison; corrupt storage normalises; Store round-trips through the panel.

Store (flashing LED, destination auditioning, confirm), Store As with naming (text field, dial characters, cursor, insert/delete), Exit cancel, 8 auto-storing Live slots that survive a reload, and Live-to-regular copy via Store.
Changing program discards unstored edits; Shift+Undo (Solo) restores the edited program before the last change; reverting an edit clears E; Exit cancels Store.
Program buttons (radio group) on 4 pages via Page buttons, dial browsing across all 32 with wrap, Shift+dial numeric list view on the Program OLED, Exit.

Enable/focus buttons, level faders, octave shift and effect focus/target for all seven layers (Organ A/B, Piano A/B, Synth A/B/C); each layer owns its voices; effects edits reach only the focused chain; manual Organ/Piano/Synth focus and Synth group.

Three split points at the 11 positions C2-C7 (ordered), up to 4 zones with Off-point merging, per-layer KB zones via Shift+Octave with zone LEDs, split LEDs above the keybed, Off/±6/±12 equal-power crossfades measured in routing gains and rendered audio, edited from the panel (Shift+Split, dial, page).

Wheel and Control Pedal (on-screen, MIDI CC11) morphs: latch-assign by moving destinations, several destinations rising/falling, linear interpolation audible in rendered audio, knob morph LEDs, level/drawbar LED-graph morph ranges, single-assignment removal and Shift+source clear; every spec destination is morphable.
Layer Scene I/II keeps separate layer enables only; sound parameters are shared; LED shows Scene II; the factory scene program switches layers audibly.

Two organ layers own their voices (different models at once), disable/release cleanup to baseline nodes, per-layer level and octave, focus to the shared organ chain, one effect chain reaching both layers.

B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe 1 harmonic profiles and attacks are distinct; every drawbar adds its footage partial and changes live notes; Farf register switches; Vox filtered/unfiltered bar; B3 Bass and Pipe 2 reuse documented; percussion on/soft/fast/third and single triggering; key click; vibrato/chorus V1-3/C1-3 with per-layer on/off; drawbar LED graphs.
Rotary ORGAN routing (stereo motion), slow→fast acceleration and Stop mode deceleration of the rotor speed params, drive changes the routed sound, speed morphable from the wheel.

Three independent layers and chains; the exact 14-waveform list in five categories with textbook Pure signatures; categories audibly distinct; Osc Ctrl none/sync formant/multi detune/super detune/FM index.

LP12/LP24/HP/BP, cutoff, resonance, key tracking and drive change rendered audio; filter envelope amount and velocity; amp attack/decay/sustain-mode/release and velocity levels; oscillator envelope to Osc Ctrl or pitch.

Poly vs Mono/Legato single voice with last/low/high priority, Mono retrigger vs Legato, constant-rate glide, unison width, vibrato On/Wheel, LFO five waveforms and three destinations, LFO off keeps settings, master-clock-synced LFO rate.
Deterministic arpeggiator: exact step times from the master clock, Up/Down/Up-Down/Random (seeded) over 1-4 octaves, unsynced rate, KB Hold latch, Run off, Poly chord steps and Gate chopping.

All engines through one AudioContext and one master path (Master Level silences all), programs/scenes/zones/morphs across engines, Master Clock tap/dial driving synced delay and arps, Transpose ±6 for every engine, Panic (Shift+Transpose and UI) stopping every voice and resetting held inputs, Solo, and unmount cleanup of timers/listeners/context.

Every panel control is functional (with a description) or listed as unsupported with its spec clause, never both; the UI notes list every unsupported control and excluded Shift function; every functional control changes canonical state, a performance input or the program UI when operated.
All Phase 1-2 test files remain present and green (decorative assertions narrowed to the controls that stay unsupported in Phase 3).
